metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a 64-channel BioSemi system while participants read and rated poetic and non-poetic texts on five dimensions using a 7-point scale. Behavioural ratings and psychometric questionnaire responses (e.g., PANAS, Openness, VVIQ, AVIQ, MAAS, AReA) were collected alongside EEG. Resting-state EEG was recorded at the start and end of each session, identifiable via specific trigger codes in the events.tsv files. Preprocessing was performed using a MATLAB script (Preprocessing.m) with channel locations defined via BioSemi64.loc.
